Gov. Henry McMaster, Lt. Gov. Pamela S. Evette, and First Lady Peggy McMaster’s Weekly Schedule, October 5, 2026

           October 6, 2026

COLUMBIA, S.C. –
 Gov. Henry McMaster, Lt. Gov. Pamela S. Evette, and First Lady Peggy McMaster’s schedules for the week of October 5, 2026, include the following:

Wednesday, October 7 at 6:00 PM: Gov. McMaster will attend an event hosted by Mayor Daniel J. Rickenmann to recognize the City of Columbia’s Inaugural Class of Mayor’s Ripples of Impact Award, The Lace House, 803 Richland Street, Columbia, S.C. 
﻿
﻿Note: 
This is a private, invitation-only event; however, members of the media are encouraged to attend. Media planning to attend are asked to RSVP to 
pio@columbiasc.gov
 by 12:00 PM on Wednesday, October 7, 2026.

Friday, October 9 at 10:30 AM: Gov. McMaster will be the commencement speaker at the South Carolina Highway Patrol Graduation ceremony for Basic Class 132, S.C. Criminal Justice Academy, 5400 Broad River Road, Columbia, S.C.﻿
﻿
-###-﻿
﻿
Gov. Henry McMaster's Weekly Schedule: September 28, 2026
﻿
﻿
COLUMBIA, S.C. –
 Gov. Henry McMaster’s schedule for the week of September 28, 2026, included:﻿
﻿
Monday, September 28

1:00 PM: Policy meeting.

4:30 PM: Economic development call.  

Tuesday, September 29

11:00 AM: Gov. McMaster attended the 3rd Annual South Carolina Nuclear Summit, Colonial Life Arena, 801 Lincoln Street, Columbia, SC 29201.

11:45 AM: Economic development meeting.

Gov. McMaster was in the Office of the Governor for office hours, Statehouse, first floor, 1100 Gervais Street, Columbia, S.C.

3:30 PM: Policy meeting.

5:30 PM: Gov. McMaster and First Lady Peggy McMaster hosted a ceremonial bill signing and reception recognizing the State Song “Carolina When I Die”, Governor’s Mansion, 800 Richland Street, Columbia, S.C. 

Wednesday, September 30

Gov. McMaster was in the Office of the Governor, Statehouse, first floor, 1100 Gervais Street, Columbia, S.C.

1:20 PM: Policy meeting.

2:10 PM: Gov. McMaster held a ceremonial bill signing for H.4591, Stop Harm from Addictive Social Media, Governor’s Office, first floor, Statehouse, 1100 Gervais Street, Columbia, S.C.

2:30 PM: Gov. McMaster presented the Order of the Palmetto to Dr. Delores Dacosta.

3:00 PM: Economic development meeting.

4:30 PM: Gov. McMaster held a ceremonial bill signing for S. 32, Pregnancy Care Tax Credit, Governor’s Office, first floor, Statehouse, 1100 Gervais Street, Columbia, S.C.

5:30 PM: Gov. McMaster and First Lady Peggy McMaster attended a Palmetto Promise Institute reception, Governor’s Mansion, 800 Richland Street, Columbia, S.C.

Friday, October 2

11:00 AM: Call with fellow governors.
